# Agency workspaces: child workspaces, transfers and their teams

An agency or a reseller runs one CHILD workspace per client under its own (the parent): each child has its own keywords, alerts, channels, members, data and wallet, and one client never sees another's. Use them when the user manages separate clients; a single company separating campaigns wants keyword groups instead (rules/keywords.md). One level only: a child holds no children.

`GET /v1/workspaces` lists the children with each one's wallet, monthly limit, automatic refill and counts; `POST /v1/workspaces` creates one (`name`, an optional `externalId` that is the user's own client id, unique), and the parent must have topped up once (`402 funding_required`). To work INSIDE a child, send the same credential with the header `Mentio-Workspace: org_...`: every endpoint then reads and writes the child (keywords, mentions, alerts, usage), and `GET /v1/whoami` names it with its `parentId`. A header naming anything but the credential's own child is a `403`. Each child has its own rate limit of 600 requests a minute, and all of a parent's children share 3,000.

Money never pools: a child spends only its own balance and starts at zero with no welcome credit. Fund it with `POST /v1/workspaces/{id}/transfers` (`amountCents`; `direction` `to_workspace`, the default, or `to_parent` to take money back); a transfer is refused with `402 insufficient_balance` when the payer's effective balance cannot cover it, and with `402 transfer_limit_reached` past the child's `monthlyLimitCents`. `autoRefill` (`thresholdCents`, `amountCents`) on create or `PATCH /v1/workspaces/{id}` refills a low child from the parent at most once a UTC day. `GET /v1/usage/breakdown?by=workspace` is the agency's bill, one row per workspace. `DELETE /v1/workspaces/{id}` deletes a client with all its data; its balance comes back to the parent first. Creating, funding and deleting children needs an owner or admin: signed in, or an API key one of them minted (others answer `403`). Confirm with the user before any transfer or delete.

People: `GET /v1/workspace-members` lists everyone across the parent and its children; `POST /v1/workspace-invitations` invites one address to several children, and `DELETE /v1/workspace-members/{id}` removes a person from children. Both need a signed-in owner or admin (an OAuth sign-in), never an API key. The parent's own owners and admins manage every child without being members of it.

Base URL `https://api.mentio.dev`, `Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY` on every request, JSON in and out. The `mentio` CLI command for each endpoint is listed for when it is installed (rules/cli.md).

## Examples

```bash
# The agency's clients
curl -sS "https://api.mentio.dev/v1/workspaces" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY"

# A new client, funded with $50 and refilled with $20 when under $5
curl -sS -X POST "https://api.mentio.dev/v1/workspaces" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"name": "Acme Corp", "externalId": "cust_42", "autoRefill": {"thresholdCents": 500, "amountCents": 2000}}'
curl -sS -X POST "https://api.mentio.dev/v1/workspaces/org_.../transfers" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"amountCents": 5000}'

# Work inside the client: same key, one header
curl -sS "https://api.mentio.dev/v1/keywords" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY" -H "Mentio-Workspace: org_..."

# The bill per client this month
curl -sS "https://api.mentio.dev/v1/usage/breakdown?by=workspace&month=2026-11" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY"
```

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | CLI | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/v1/workspaces` | `mentio workspaces:list` | List child workspaces |
| `POST` | `/v1/workspaces` | `mentio workspaces:create` | Create a child workspace |
| `GET` | `/v1/workspaces/{id}` | `mentio workspaces:get` | Get a child workspace |
| `PATCH` | `/v1/workspaces/{id}` | `mentio workspaces:update` | Update a child workspace |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/workspaces/{id}` | `mentio workspaces:delete` | Delete a child workspace |
| `GET` | `/v1/workspaces/{id}/transfers` | `mentio workspaces:transfers` | List a child workspace's transfers |
| `POST` | `/v1/workspaces/{id}/transfers` | `mentio workspaces:transfer` | Move money to or from a child workspace |
| `GET` | `/v1/workspace-members` | `mentio workspace-members:list` | List members across your workspaces |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/workspace-members/{id}` | `mentio workspace-members:remove` | Remove someone from your child workspaces |
| `POST` | `/v1/workspace-invitations` | `mentio workspace-invitations:create` | Invite someone to several child workspaces |

### GET /v1/workspaces

**List child workspaces.** The child workspaces your workspace created, oldest first, each with its own wallet, its funding settings and counts. Act inside one by sending its id as the `Mentio-Workspace` header on any other call. See [Agency workspaces](/guides/agency-workspaces).

CLI: `mentio workspaces:list`

Returns: 200, a `InvoiceList` (see Shapes below).

### POST /v1/workspaces

**Create a child workspace.** A workspace of its own for a client, apart from yours and your other clients'. It starts with no balance and no welcome credit: fund it with a transfer or `autoRefill`. See [Agency workspaces](/guides/agency-workspaces).

CLI: `mentio workspaces:create`

Body (JSON):

- `name` (string, required): The workspace name, 1 to 100 characters.
- `externalId` (string): Your own id for it (a customer id), unique among your workspaces; a second create with the same one is a 409.
- `monthlyLimitCents` (integer, nullable): The most you move into it in a UTC calendar month, in USD cents; omit or null for no limit.
- `autoRefill` (object, nullable): Refill it from your balance when it runs low; omit or null for off.
  - `thresholdCents` (integer, required): Refill when the child's effective balance (balance minus usage not settled yet) drops under this, in USD cents.
  - `amountCents` (integer, required): How much each refill moves from the parent, in USD cents (100 to 500000).

Returns: 201, a `Workspace` (see Shapes below).

### GET /v1/workspaces/{id}

**Get a child workspace.**

CLI: `mentio workspaces:get`

Path:

- `id` (string, required): Child workspace id (org_...).

Returns: 200, a `Workspace` (see Shapes below).

### PATCH /v1/workspaces/{id}

**Update a child workspace.** Rename it, change its externalId, its monthly limit on transfers in or its automatic refill. Omitted fields stay; null clears.

CLI: `mentio workspaces:update`

Path:

- `id` (string, required): Child workspace id (org_...).

Body (JSON):

- `name` (string): New name, 1 to 100 characters.
- `externalId` (string, nullable): Your own id for it; null clears it.
- `monthlyLimitCents` (integer, nullable): The monthly ceiling on transfers in, in USD cents; null removes it.
- `autoRefill` (object, nullable): The automatic refill; null turns it off.
  - `thresholdCents` (integer, required): Refill when the child's effective balance (balance minus usage not settled yet) drops under this, in USD cents.
  - `amountCents` (integer, required): How much each refill moves from the parent, in USD cents (100 to 500000).

Returns: 200, a `Workspace` (see Shapes below).

### DELETE /v1/workspaces/{id}

**Delete a child workspace.** Deletes the workspace with everything in it: keywords, mentions, alerts, channels, API keys, members. Its effective balance comes back to your workspace first, and usage it owes is settled from yours. Cannot be undone.

CLI: `mentio workspaces:delete`

Path:

- `id` (string, required): Child workspace id (org_...).

Returns: 204, no body.

### GET /v1/workspaces/{id}/transfers

**List a child workspace's transfers.** Every transfer between your workspace and this child, newest first, automatic refills included.

CLI: `mentio workspaces:transfers`

Path:

- `id` (string, required): Child workspace id (org_...).

Query:

- `cursor` (string): The nextCursor of the previous page.
- `limit` (integer): Transfers per page, 1 to 100 (default 50).

Returns: 200, a `LedgerList` (see Shapes below).

### POST /v1/workspaces/{id}/transfers

**Move money to or from a child workspace.** Moves USD cents between your balance and the child's, one ledger row on each side. The payer's effective balance must cover it; a transfer in counts against the child's monthly limit. Nothing charges a card or pays out. See [Agency workspaces](/guides/agency-workspaces#fund-a-child).

CLI: `mentio workspaces:transfer`

Path:

- `id` (string, required): Child workspace id (org_...).

Body (JSON):

- `amountCents` (integer, required): How much to move, in USD cents (1 to 500000).
- `direction` (string): one of `to_workspace`, `to_parent`. to_workspace: from the parent into the child workspace. to_parent: from the child back to the parent.
- `note` (string): Free text kept on both ledger rows, up to 200 characters.

Returns: 201, a `Transfer` (see Shapes below).

### GET /v1/workspace-members

**List members across your workspaces.** Everyone in your workspace or its children, one row per person. Each row lists the workspaces they belong to and their role in each.

CLI: `mentio workspace-members:list`

Returns: 200, a `InvoiceList` (see Shapes below).

### DELETE /v1/workspace-members/{id}

**Remove someone from your child workspaces.** Removes the person from every child workspace, or from the ones `workspaceIds` names, or from all but `notWorkspaceIds`. Never from your own workspace (that is DELETE /v1/members/{id}). Needs a signed-in owner or admin, not an API key.

CLI: `mentio workspace-members:remove`

Path:

- `id` (string, required): The person's user id, from GET /v1/workspace-members.

Query:

- `workspaceIds` (array of string, nullable): Only from these child workspaces (org_...); default every child. Never the parent: its own team is managed on /v1/members. Repeatable, or comma-separated.
- `notWorkspaceIds` (array of string, nullable): From every child workspace except these (org_...). Repeatable, or comma-separated.

Returns: 204, no body.

### POST /v1/workspace-invitations

**Invite someone to several child workspaces.** Invites one address to several child workspaces, one email each. A member or an open invitation is reported, never sent twice. Needs a signed-in owner or admin, not an API key.

CLI: `mentio workspace-invitations:create`

Body (JSON):

- `email` (string, required): The address to invite; it receives one email per workspace with a link to join.
- `role` (string): one of `admin`, `member`. The role they join each workspace with.
- `workspaceIds` (array of string, required): The child workspaces (org_...) to invite them to.

Returns: 201, a `InvoiceList` (see Shapes below).

## Shapes

### InvoiceList

- `data` (array of object, required): Paid orders, newest first; empty before the first top-up.
  - `id` (string, required): The Polar order id; what GET /v1/billing/invoices/{id}/url takes.
  - `createdAt` (string, required): When the order was placed (ISO 8601).
  - `status` (string, required): The order status as Polar reports it (paid, refunded, ...).
  - `paid` (boolean, required): Whether the order was paid.
  - `totalAmount` (integer, required): What was charged, in minor units of `currency`, tax included.
  - `currency` (string, required): ISO 4217 currency of the order (usd).
  - `billingReason` (string, required, nullable): Why the order exists, as Polar reports it (purchase, subscription_cycle, ...); null when it does not say.

### Workspace

- `id` (string, required): Workspace id (org_...); send it as the Mentio-Workspace header to act on this workspace with the parent's credential.
- `name` (string, required): The workspace name.
- `externalId` (string, required, nullable): Your own id for this workspace (a customer id), unique among your workspaces; null when unset.
- `parentId` (string, required): The parent workspace (org_...) that created and funds it.
- `createdAt` (string, required): When the workspace was created.
- `wallet` (object, required): The child's own wallet. A child spends only what it holds; nothing is pooled with the parent.
  - `balanceCents` (integer, required): The workspace's own balance: every credit and transfer in, minus every debit and transfer out.
  - `effectiveCents` (integer, required): The balance minus usage not settled yet: what a transfer back to the parent may take, and what the stop rules read.
  - `activeKeywords` (integer, required): Keywords running (each costs a keyword-day a day).
  - `pausedKeywords` (integer, required): Keywords the wallet paused for lack of balance; they resume once a day of every keyword is covered.
- `funding` (object, required): How the parent funds this workspace.
  - `monthlyLimitCents` (integer, required, nullable): The most the parent moves into this workspace in a UTC calendar month, manual and automatic transfers alike; null = no limit.
  - `transferredThisMonthCents` (integer, required): Moved in from the parent this UTC month, what the monthly limit counts.
  - `autoRefill` (object, required, nullable): The automatic refill; null when off.
    - `thresholdCents` (integer, required): Refill when the child's effective balance (balance minus usage not settled yet) drops under this, in USD cents.
    - `amountCents` (integer, required): How much each refill moves from the parent, in USD cents (100 to 500000).
  - `lastRefillAt` (string, required, nullable): When the last automatic refill moved money; null when none ever did.
  - `lastRefillError` (string, required, nullable): Why the last automatic refill attempt moved nothing (the parent could not cover it, the monthly limit), cleared by the next one that works; null when fine.
- `stats` (object, required): Counts.
  - `keywords` (integer, required): Keywords in the workspace, running or not.
  - `members` (integer, required): People who are members of this workspace itself (the parent's team reaches it through the parent).

### LedgerList

- `data` (array of object, required): Ledger entries, newest first.
  - `id` (string, required): Ledger entry id (led_...).
  - `kind` (string, required): one of `signup_credit`, `topup`, `refund`, `debit_keyword_days`, `debit_mentions`, `debit_comments`, `debit_searches`, `debit_estimates`, `debit_account_days`, `debit_followers`, `adjustment`, `transfer_in`, `transfer_out`. The row kind:

- Credits: signup_credit, topup, adjustment, transfer_in (from the parent or a child workspace).
- Out: refund, transfer_out.
- Debits: debit_keyword_days, debit_mentions, debit_comments, debit_searches, debit_estimates, debit_account_days (tracked accounts), debit_followers (new followers).
  - `amountCents` (integer, required): Integer USD cents; credits positive, debits negative.
  - `day` (string, required, nullable): Debit rows: the last UTC day the row settled (YYYY-MM-DD).
  - `units` (integer, required, nullable): Debit rows: cumulative units (mentions, keyword-days, account-days or followers) settled up to this row; on debit_estimates, the paid samples of that one estimate.
  - `note` (string, required, nullable): Free text on credits and adjustments.
  - `polarOrderId` (string, required, nullable): Top-ups and refunds: the Polar order.
  - `transfer` (object, required, nullable): transfer_in and transfer_out rows: the transfer and the other workspace; null on every other row.
    - `id` (string, required): Transfer id (trf_...); the other workspace's row carries the same id.
    - `workspaceId` (string, required): The other workspace of the transfer (org_...): the child it funded, or the parent it came from.
  - `createdAt` (string, required): ISO 8601 timestamp, UTC.
- `nextCursor` (string, required, nullable): Pass it back as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last.

### Transfer

- `id` (string, required): Transfer id (trf_...).
- `workspaceId` (string, required): The child workspace (org_...).
- `direction` (string, required): one of `to_workspace`, `to_parent`. to_workspace: from the parent into the child workspace. to_parent: from the child back to the parent.
- `amountCents` (integer, required): How much moved, in USD cents, always positive; `direction` says which way.
- `note` (string, required, nullable): Free text written with it; automatic refills read "Automatic refill".
- `createdAt` (string, required): When the money moved.
